svg.title: A small board on its own, and the same board in a panel
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan view of the end of one machine's conveyor and the start of the next, about 50 mm apart, twice. Top, marked wrong: a 15 by 10 mm board on its own has just left the first conveyor and has nothing under it; it is far shorter than the gap. Bottom, marked right: the same board in a panel of 24, 120 by 50 mm with 10 mm rails, rests on both conveyors at once; it is longer than twice the gap, so it never hangs more than halfway off a conveyor and tips.

g.text: ✗ A 15 × 10 mm board on its own
✓ The same board in a 120 × 50 mm panel
120 mm panel: more than twice the gap
Nothing under it in the gap
On both conveyors before it can tip
Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm. Gap between machines from PCB-DFA-002.
